Assuming I am more skilled that I am at coding and I have way more time than I actually have, what would I use to cluster 256x256 1D data?

We acquire a 256x256 pixels image at which point we do a measurement (that is an array of length that depends on the measurement but it always the same inside an image). I know that my image is composed of 3 areas (maybe need to account for a 4th one for the spurious points). I want to be able to separate the 3 areas based on the features of the array. By visual inspection, it is easy to say whether the clustering is reasonable or not (I know where the areas are)
Next step would be to get an average (or something more sensible) of the array in each of the area and compare it between the 3 areas.

We have done brute force fitting of all the arrays with a sensible model and plotted the results, but it's inconclusive (distribution of results is larger than the difference of mean). 

#MachineLearning
